message:
♦️ **FLEX GUI PRO V9.1.5 IS LIVE! (AFTER EFFECTS)**[cite: 7]

A dedicated workflow release bringing multi-layer Effects Control, a project Downgrader, streamlined Un-Precompose, and timeline management upgrades[cite: 7].

*(Install with your ZXP installer and restart After Effects once to load the update[cite: 7].)*

♦️ **New Multi-Layer Effects Control (Timeline Manager ▸ FX CONTROL)**
* **Global Multi-Layer Stack:** Select multiple layers to view their common effects in a unified stack[cite: 7]. Adjusting values, colors, dropdowns, layer orders, or deletions applies instantly across every selected layer in a single undo step[cite: 7].
* **Safe Application Bar:** Layers missing an effect are never modified silently—the panel lists them with options to Ignore or Apply anyway with matched parameters[cite: 7].
* **Math & Relative Values:** Number fields accept inline math (1920/2, +=10, *=1.5), relative property differences are maintained during multi-layer dragging, and keyframe diamonds feature full toggle and stopwatch controls[cite: 7].

♦️ **Project Downgrader (FX & Advanced Rigs ▸ FX & Presets)**
* **Open Newer AEP Projects:** Open project files created in newer After Effects versions directly in your current install[cite: 7]. Operates safely on a dedicated copy with automatic original file backup[cite: 7].

♦️ **Rebuilt Un-Precompose Engine**
* **Clean Timelines Without Helpers:** No longer generates hidden transform parent layers for standard layers[cite: 7]. Subtitle pop-ins and keyframes bake directly onto native text layers, drastically speeding up long timeline extractions[cite: 7].
* **Intelligent 3D & Adjustment Handling:** Extracts precomps containing 3D or adjustment layers when appearance is unaffected, and provides explicit warning prompts if an adjustment layer will alter underlying timeline layers[cite: 7].

♦️ **Timeline Manager & Quality of Life**
* **Batch Rename:** Renames layers with label swatches matched to your real After Effects color preferences[cite: 7].
* **Expression Library:** Added a curated Recommended view and fixed saved custom expressions not displaying after application restarts[cite: 7].
* **Clean UI:** Silenced the harmless ResizeObserver loop limit exceeded browser notice box[cite: 7].
